LadonDPsgdAudit.public_gap_convergence {n d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (q : NNReal) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
  (eta L c sigmaSG sigmaDP : ℝ) (heta : 0 < eta) (hL : 0 < L) (hc : 0 < c) (hsg : 0 ≤ sigmaSG) (hs : 0 ≤ sigmaDP)
  (hclip : 4 * sigmaSG ≤ c) (hstep : eta * L * (1 + (1 - ↑q) / (↑q * ↑n)) ≤ 1)
  (g : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hg : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (g i))
  (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), HasGradientAt f (vectorMean fun i => g i x) x)
  (hLip : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖(vectorMean fun i => g i x) - vectorMean fun i => g i y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
  (hvariance :
    ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), meanSqDeviation (fun i => g i x) (vectorMean fun i => g i x) ≤ sigmaSG ^ 2)
  (fLower : ℝ) (hlower : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), fLower ≤ f x) (x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (T : ℕ)
  (hT : 0 < T) (F : ℝ) (hF : f x0 - fLower ≤ F) :
  (↑T)⁻¹ *
      ∑ t,
        ∫ (ω : Trajectory.History d (Fin n → Bool) T),
          ‖vectorMean fun i => g i (gaussianIterate eta (↑q) c g x0 T ↑t ⋯ ω)‖ ∂gaussianHistoryLaw n d T q hq1 sigmaDP ≤
    √(poissonRateD eta L ((1 - ↑q) / (↑q * ↑n)) sigmaSG sigmaDP F (↑T) c) +
      poissonRateD eta L ((1 - ↑q) / (↑q * ↑n)) sigmaSG sigmaDP F (↑T) c / c

LadonDPsgdAudit.gdp_coefficient {n d : ℕ} (eta L sigma F c : ℝ) {q T mu : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hT : 0 < T) (hmu : 0 < mu) :
  poissonRateD eta L ((1 - q) / (q * ↑n)) sigma (gdpFormulaNoise n d q T c mu) F T c =
    4 * F / (eta * T) + 8 * sigma ^ 4 / c ^ 2 +
      2 * eta * L *
        ((1 - q) / (q * ↑n) * sigma ^ 2 + c ^ 2 * ↑d / (↑n ^ 2 * q ^ 2 * Real.log (1 + mu ^ 2 / (T * q ^ 2))))

Mf.Optimization.PoissonClippedSGD.gdpUpper_retuned_antitone_batch {L n d q q' sigma F T c mu : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
  (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hq : 0 < q) (hqq : q ≤ q') (hq'1 : q' ≤ 1) (hF : 0 < F) (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 < c)
  (hmu : 0 < mu) :
  have Q := gdpTotalVariance n d q T c sigma mu;
  have Q' := gdpTotalVariance n d q' T c sigma mu;
  have cap := poissonStepCap L ((1 - q) / (q * n));
  have cap' := poissonStepCap L ((1 - q') / (q' * n));
  stationarityUpper c (gdpFormulaD (optimalStep F T L Q' cap') L n d q' sigma F T c mu) ≤
    stationarityUpper c (gdpFormulaD (optimalStep F T L Q cap) L n d q sigma F T c mu)
